**Image 1 (About Section):**
*   **Layout & Alignment:** Clean and well-structured. The two-column layout (Avatar left, Text right) is balanced, with the large "01" watermark correctly positioned in the background without obscuring text.
*   **Elements Check:**
    *   **Avatar:** Present with a subtle grid background and a glowing "MS" monogram.
    *   **Ring/Status:** A "Available for freelance" pill is visible at the bottom of the avatar card.
    *   **Word-Reveal:** The word "*magic*" is styled distinctively (italic/purple) within the main heading.
    *   **Marquee Strip:** A horizontal scrolling bar at the bottom lists skills ("Creative Development", "UI/UX Design", etc.) separated by sparkles.
*   **Issues:** No overlapping or broken elements detected. Everything appears pixel-perfect.

**Image 2 (Bento Highlights Grid):**
*   **Layout & Alignment:** Standard Bento grid layout (2 columns). The spacing between the large project card on the left and the stacked cards on the right looks consistent.
*   **Elements Check:**
    *   **Featured Project Card:** Large image card for "Nebula — SaaS Analytics Platform" with a "Featured" badge.
    *   **Big Stat Card:** Top-right card displays "5+ Years of Experience" with a large font size and an icon button.
    *   **Tech Orbit:** Bottom-right card shows the "MS" center node with rotating skill chips (REST, Figma, Next.js, etc.) arranged in an orbit pattern.
    *   **Mini Stats/CTA:** Only the top portion of the grid is visible; mini-stat tiles and a specific CTA card are likely further down or off-screen in this specific crop.
*   **Issues:** No visual bugs, misalignments, or overlapping text observed. The "02" watermark is properly placed in the upper right corner.
